_comment: [OPUS-4.8] Machine-readable OpenSSF Best-Practices (CII) badge self-certification for sparq (bead sq-toze.5, gap GX-4, epic sq-toze). This is the STRUCTURED form of the drafted answers in compliance/openssf/evidence.md §Badge: one object per bestpractices.dev criterion id, with a status, a one-line justification, and the repo-relative evidence path(s) that back it. It is the import-ready payload a maintainer transcribes into the bestpractices.dev questionnaire (GX-4 remains an EXTERNAL human-owned filing step the agent cannot perform). scripts/check-bestpractices-evidence.py GATES this file: every cited evidence path must resolve to a real repo artifact and every status/level must be a valid token, so the self-certification cannot silently drift. Authored while Fable unavailable — re-review when Fable returns. NON-CANONICAL timing; no measured numbers here.
